limitations: User visual approval is pending. Only views directly presented and subsequently accepted enter the approved baseline.
Google and Phantom are separate identities. Reusing the same synthetic username in alternative previews does not create account linking.
Phantom is the existing browser-injected Solana provider; mobile layout does not add a mobile wallet deep-link flow.

The static preview simulates username checks after 400ms using a few example unavailable names. Server validation, safety list, cancellation, race/CSRF/ticket semantics, real redirect/returnTo and deployment paths remain production obligations.
No authorization, account creation or identity switch is performed by the prototype. Its actions show clearly labeled local feedback.
Real registration starts with an empty username. Default screenshots intentionally show a synthetic completed input and available result to review the form and primary button.
The current React baseline is GET-fixture evidence only. Registration source has existing dark-theme contrast differences; current ui/ is untouched.
Administrator, all provider reason codes and live end-to-end authentication are outside this visual acceptance. No full-system smoke ran.
No service was started. The existing root Vite was borrowed, then preserved; all task browsers closed.
